stories.title: Ransom Cartel ransomware creator sentenced to 16 years in prison
stories.summary: Maksim Silnikau, a 40‑year‑old Belarusian and former member of Russian‑speaking cybercrime forums, was sentenced to 16 years in U.S. federal prison after orchestrating the Ransom Cartel ransomware‑as‑a‑service operation that launched in December 2021 and attacked at least 18 companies worldwide from 2021‑2023, demanding over $5.2 million in ransoms and causing an estimated $6.7 million in losses. stories.title: Mount Toba eruption doesn't seem like it could nearly kill our species
stories.summary: Mount Toba’s 74,000‑year‑old eruption, the largest in the last 2.6 million years, spewed thousands of cubic kilometres of magma—about a thousand times more than the 1991 Pinatubo blast—and was once feared to have caused a planet‑wide “volcanic winter” that could have threatened early human survival.
